title: GalNX Engine Descriptor
description: Versioned record of one engine runtime adapter: upstream source, pinned commit, license, target, build backend, capability model, default input profile, artifact naming, content layout and the engine-level verification summary.

pinned_commit.description: 40 hex character commit pinned for source builds.

pinned_version.description: Human readable pinned version, e.g. krkrsdl2@124bdf84 (2026-10-01).

license_spdx.description: SPDX license id for the component GalNX depends on.

license_url.description: Link to the license evidence (LICENSE file, release note).

license_notes.description: Main repo license vs bundled third-party components.

capabilities.description: Capability model: graphics renders the game, movie decodes video. Deprecated alias video -> graphics is accepted with a warning during loading; never write video in a new descriptor.

default_input_profile.description: Built-in input profile name from galnx.input (kb_mouse, generic-vn, krkrsdl2, krkr-ns).

artifact_naming.description: Template using {id}, {version}, {target}, {kind}. Must end with .nro for nro/web targets and .nsp for self_contained_nsp.

entry.description: Entry file name inside the content tree (e.g. data.xp3, index.html).

destination.description: Where the content tree lives (e.g. romfs/data.xp3, sdmc:/switch/brewser/apps/<app-id>/).

status_reason.description: Required when status is research or blocked.

artifact_sha256.description: Expected artifact hash when the artifact is prebuilt or reproducible.

evidence_urls.description: Audit/build docs that back the descriptor claims.

source.description: Machine-readable upstream source pin used by 'galnx engines prepare'.

url.description: Clone URL used when --fetch is given (git clone).

commit.description: Commit to check out after cloning; must match pinned_commit when both are set.

submodules.description: Submodules that the build needs (informational for offline prepare).

patches.description: Patch files applied by 'galnx engines prepare' after checking out the pin.

path.description: Path to a unified git patch (relative to the working directory or the descriptor file).

portlibs.description: Port libraries built out-of-tree for this engine; recorded in the engine lock.

recipe.description: Path or short description of the build recipe.

build.description: Machine-readable build entry point for this engine.

capability.description: One capability entry. supported/note stay backwards compatible; verification records how the claim was checked.

note.description: Free-form note; required by the loader but not by the raw JSON schema.

verification.description: Required for graphics/movie/audio/input/save; optional for touch.

backend.description: Implementation backend, e.g. sdl2-egl, ffmpeg, nvdec, sdl2-mixer+vorbis.

features.description: Named sub-features, e.g. nv12-zero-copy, h264-hw-decode, software-fallback.

details.description: Arbitrary JSON object for backend-specific details; documentation only, never parsed by the build.

engineVerification.description: Engine-level verification summary (the whole engine, not one game). Per-game acceptance lives in docs/engines/verification-matrix.md.

status.description: Verification level for the engine as a whole, e.g. device_verified, emulator_verified, partial, unknown.

hardware.description: Hardware/emulator used, e.g. Nintendo Switch, Citron Nightly 0237a9b88.

firmware.description: Firmware version, empty when not recorded.

atmosphere.description: Atmosphere version, empty when not recorded.

tested_at.description: Date of the latest verification run (YYYY-MM-DD).

evidence.description: Repository paths or URLs that back the summary.
